nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 3
nodes.description: Grade 3

nodes.title: Life Skills
nodes.description: Life Skills for Grade 3 — Foundation Phase CAPS. Study areas: Beginning Knowledge (BK), Personal and Social Well-being (PSW), Creative Arts, Physical Education (PE)

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 3 Life Skills Term 1

metadata.capsReference: Grade 3 Life Skills ATP Term 1

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Orientation and Baseline
nodes.description: Orientation to Grade 3; baseline assessment activities; revisiting Grade 2 content; classroom routines and rules

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Orientation

nodes.title: PSW & BK: About Me — My Timeline
nodes.description: Personal history and life timeline; significant events in learner's life; growth and change over time; identity and culture; using photographs and documents

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: About Me — My Timeline

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Feelings and Emotions
nodes.description: Identifying complex feelings; expressing and managing emotions appropriately; empathy and compassion; coping with difficult emotions; emotions and decision-making

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being: Feelings and Emotions

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Health Protection and First Aid
nodes.description: Common illnesses and how to prevent them; basic first aid for cuts and bruises; what to do in an emergency; immunisation and healthcare; hygiene and disease prevention

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Health Protection and First Aid

nodes.title: PSW: Keeping My Body Safe and Rights and Responsibilities
nodes.description: Body safety and personal boundaries; children's rights and responsibilities; safety rules in school and community; being a responsible citizen

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being: Keeping My Body Safe / Rights and Responsibilities

nodes.title: Creative Arts — Visual Arts
nodes.description: Exploring and experimenting with mixed media; drawing self-portraits; collage using personal photographs and clippings; colour mixing and application

metadata.capsReference: Creative Arts: Visual Arts

nodes.title: Physical Education
nodes.description: Body management: balance and coordination; locomotor skills: running, skipping, jumping; athletic events; simple team games and sport

metadata.capsReference: Physical Education

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 3 Life Skills Term 2

metadata.capsReference: Grade 3 Life Skills ATP Term 2

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Healthy Eating — Food Groups
nodes.description: The five food groups; nutrients and their functions; planning a balanced meal; unhealthy food and its effects; food labelling and advertising

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Healthy Eating — Food Groups

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Insects
nodes.description: Characteristics of insects; parts of an insect; useful and harmful insects; habitats; how insects are different from other animals

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Insects

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Life Cycles
nodes.description: Life cycle of a frog (egg, tadpole, froglet, frog); life cycle of a chicken (egg, chick, adult); comparing life cycles; changes during life cycles; life cycles in nature

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Life Cycles

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Recycling
nodes.description: What recycling is and why it is important; types of materials that can be recycled; reduce, reuse, recycle; environmental impact of waste; school and home recycling projects

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Recycling

nodes.title: Creative Arts — Visual Arts
nodes.description: Drawing and painting insects and nature scenes; observational drawing from real specimens; collage with natural and recycled materials; printmaking

metadata.capsReference: Creative Arts: Visual Arts

nodes.title: Creative Arts — Performing Arts
nodes.description: Drama: acting out life cycles and nature themes; Music: songs about nature and animals; Dance: movement imitating insects and animals

metadata.capsReference: Creative Arts: Performing Arts

nodes.title: Physical Education
nodes.description: Athletic skills: running, jumping, throwing; ball games and team sports; coordination and balance activities; swimming or water activities

metadata.capsReference: Physical Education

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 3 Life Skills Term 3 (content based on CAPS curriculum scope)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 3 Life Skills CAPS Term 3

nodes.title: PSW & BK: The Economy and Trade
nodes.description: Buying and selling; goods and services; money and trade; local markets; economic roles in the community

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: The Economy and Trade

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Planets and Space
nodes.description: The solar system; planets and their characteristics; the sun, earth and moon; day and night; stars and constellations

metadata.capsReference: Beginning Knowledge: Planets and Space

nodes.title: PSW: Relationships and Conflict Resolution
nodes.description: Healthy and unhealthy relationships; resolving conflict peacefully; peer pressure; saying no; bullying and how to deal with it

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being: Relationships and Conflict Resolution

nodes.title: Creative Arts
nodes.description: Visual arts: drawing, painting, sculpture linked to themes; Performing Arts: drama, music and dance linked to topics

metadata.capsReference: Creative Arts

nodes.title: Physical Education
nodes.description: Team sports; athletic events; swimming or water safety; gymnastics and movement; games that develop coordination

metadata.capsReference: Physical Education

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 3 Life Skills Term 4 (content based on CAPS curriculum scope)

metadata.capsReference: Grade 3 Life Skills CAPS Term 4

nodes.title: PSW & BK: South Africa and Its History
nodes.description: South African history: key events; heritage and culture; national symbols; notable South Africans; celebrating South Africa

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: South Africa and Its History

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Weather and Climate
nodes.description: Weather versus climate; climate zones in South Africa; effects of climate on lifestyle; natural disasters; climate change awareness

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Weather and Climate

nodes.title: PSW: Life Skills Revision and Transition
nodes.description: Revising key Life Skills concepts from the year; preparing for Grade 4; setting personal goals; celebrating achievements

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being: Revision and Transition

nodes.title: Creative Arts
nodes.description: Visual arts: South African-themed artwork, murals, collage; Performing Arts: cultural songs, drama, heritage celebration performance

metadata.capsReference: Creative Arts

nodes.title: Physical Education
nodes.description: End-of-year sports events; consolidation of sport and game skills; team and individual athletic activities; movement expression

metadata.capsReference: Physical Education
